title: Explicit 3D Gaussian Models for Fast, Mesh-Free Compression of Structured and Unstructured Volumes
abstract: arXiv:2607.01164v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent work has shown that implicit neural representations (INRs) can be trained to effectively compress structured and unstructured volume data, allowing for direct data querying with a reduced memory footprint. However, as existing INRs for unstructured volumes do not encode geometry, they require partial mesh storage for later sampling, limiting achievable compression. At the same time, novel view synthesis methods have shown that explicit collections of 3D Gaussians can be used to accurately visualize volume data. In this work, we introduce an explicit model for volume data compression based on 3D Gaussian primitives. We reinterpret collections of 3D Gaussians as an explicit representation of a volume's scalar field and use a sampling strategy that reconstructs scalar values at spatial locations through weighted aggregation of intersecting Gaussians. We develop optimized CUDA-accelerated pipelines for structured and unstructured

translated_title: 用于结构化与非结构化体数据快速无网格压缩的显式三维高斯模型
translated_abstract: 近期研究表明，隐式神经表示经训练后可有效压缩结构化和非结构化体数据，能够在降低内存占用的同时支持直接数据查询。然而，现有的用于非结构化体的隐式神经表示不编码几何信息，需要部分网格存储以供后续采样，这限制了可实现的压缩率。与此同时，新视角合成方法已经证明，显式的三维高斯集合可用于精确可视化体数据。在本工作中，我们提出了一种基于三维高斯基元的显式体数据压缩模型。我们将三维高斯集合重新解释为体标量场的显式表示，并采用一种采样策略，通过对相交高斯进行加权聚合来重建空间位置处的标量值。我们为结构化和非结构化体数据开发了优化的CUDA加速管线
tldr: 该论文提出基于显式三维高斯基元的体数据压缩模型，通过对相交高斯进行加权聚合来重建标量场，实现了无需网格存储的结构化与非结构化体数据快速压缩。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an explicit 3D Gaussian primitive-based model for volume data compression that reconstructs scalar fields through weighted aggregation of intersecting Gaussians, enabling fast, mesh-free compression of both structured and unstructured volumes.
